title: [v0.92.2][OPS-GCP] Produce one apply-ready company GCP move-in execution packet
issue_goal_ref: Create Sprint 8 issue #909 session goal after binding and before implementation
demo_proof_requirements: Read-only GCP and Terraform plan; local consistency/redaction checks; no apply or state changes
summary: Produce the complete apply-ready company GCP move-in packet from existing reviewed Terraform foundations.
plan_steps: Verify approved company organization/project/billing identity read-only; inventory source/destination; reconcile existing Terraform; run fmt/validate and bounded read-only plan; write exact apply/rollback/go-no-go and billing/cleanup controls; review packet against actual plan and publish.
stop_conditions: Ownership collision; wrong cloud identity; missing required readback; secrets exposure; unauthorized mutation. #910 cannot deploy before #720 accepted output and precise apply/upload approval.
plan_summary: Verify company GCP identity and source/destination inventory, reconcile organization/bootstrap/platform Terraform to observed state, and deliver a reviewed apply-ready move-in packet. Missing readback or real plan blocks completion.
dependencies_inline: #864 accepted planning output and all 69 creation/review gates; umbrella #934 coordinates execution.
repo_inputs_inline: infra/gcp/organization, infra/gcp/bootstrap, infra/gcp/platform and associated docs/operations/cloud/gcp runbooks
deliverables_inline: Exact inventory; actual bounded read-only Terraform plan; ordered application and rollback; billing, cleanup ownership and residual routing.
acceptance_criteria_inline: Live company identity and inventory; fmt/validate/plan; consistency, link and redaction proof; independent review.
validation_plan_inline: Terraform fmt/validate; approved company read-only inventory and plan; document/source/link/redaction checks. No apply, import, backend creation or state mutation.
risks_inline: Missing company credentials or state, drift, wrong identity, resource ownership collision, irreversible data movement.
non_goals_inline: Runtime deployment, GPU launch, six-resident requalification, cloud mutation.
notes_risks_inline: Company authentication resolved and inventory captured. Bootstrap/organization plans produced; platform Terraform state not located. No import/state recovery authority; preserve exact original state if supplied.
